news.headline: Alphabet Kicks Off Asia Bond Sale as AI Firms Face Scrutiny
news.summary: Alphabet Inc. began marketing its inaugural Hong Kong and Singapore dollar bond sale, testing investor interest at a time of increasing volatility for companies focused on artificial intelligence.

news.headline: Zelda remake becomes fastest-selling Nintendo Switch 2 game ever
news.summary: Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa reports on "The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time" selling 5.2 million copies in its first four days on Nintendo (NTDOY) Switch 2, the device's fastest-selling game ever, ahead of next week's Grand Theft Auto 6 launch.

news.headline: Fusion's Next Race Is Over Superconducting Tape, Not Plasma
news.summary: Proxima Fusion signed deals with Japan's Fujikura and Kyoto Fusioneering to build a European fusion supply chain, starting with superconducting tape.
